missingness: pairwise complete drugs for each term; no imputation
correlation: Spearman across drugs; no p-values or hit calling; n<5 marked exploratory-insufficient; constant vectors return NA
PLIF_integration: identity/source index only; no vector weighting, joint metric or feature selection
sd_definition: sample SD of seed best scores, ddof=1
interpretation: Vina docking-score proxy, not experimental affinity; association/correspondence only
